# IP-01 Scope Report — CR-012 / FEAT34 Governed LINE Visual Office

## 1. Scope summary and status boundary

CR-012 / FEAT34 defines an authenticated, tenant-scoped Visual Office control plane inside Zuri. Its proposed route family is `/visual-office` and related protected views. It uses the existing Zuri session for server-derived actor, tenant, role, plan, and session-revocation context; it does not introduce SmartGift authentication or a second identity authority. [CR-012 §Scope; FEAT34 §§1, 3.1; API v1 §§1–2.1]

The intended control-plane scope is group registration and policy configuration, reviewer and visibility configuration, report configuration and protected report detail, read-only candidate review, and a read-only Agent Office projection. Configuration, preflight, runtime admission, and report delivery are distinct states. A saved configuration, audit ID, capability choice, schedule, or UI state is not evidence that LINE activity or delivery is live. [`docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §§Architectural Contract, Implementation Stages; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §§3–5; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§3–4.4, 6–7; `docs/design/visual-office-design-spec.md` §3]

This report does **not** treat any Visual Office endpoint, page, component, persistence model, runtime gate, or delivery path as implemented. The document graph labels the listed APIs as specified-not-implemented (with the `/office` permission pending) and the API contract as candidate-not-bound. [Doc graph nodes `doc:visual-office-api-v1`, `api:GET:/api/visual-office/overview`, `api:GET:/api/visual-office/office`, `api:POST:/api/visual-office/agents/:agentId/task-assignments`]

### Explicit non-goals

- A separate login, OAuth/OIDC provider, shared/cross-domain cookies, public Visual Office or report link, and browser-held secret. [CR-012 §Out of Scope; API v1 §§1–2.1, 7]
- LINE ingress/webhook work, arbitrary browser-supplied LINE group/OA identifiers, browser authority for tenant/RBAC/PII/runtime state, or transfer of OA credentials to the browser. [CR-012 §§Scope, Out of Scope; FEAT34 §§1, 5; API v1 §§2–4]
- Real LINE traffic, report sending, task/CRM/publish side effects, and any representation of demo fixtures or configuration as live operational data. [CR-012 §§Architectural Contract, Out of Scope; FEAT34 §§3.2–3.4, 5; API v1 §§3–4.4, 6–7]
- Global Zuri role administration from Visual Office; Visual Office may select existing tenant users as group reviewers only. [CR-012 §Architectural Contract; API v1 §2.2; Execution plan §§Non-Negotiable Gates, Contradiction and Action Ledger]
- PersistentFlow changes, GoVibe changes, GKS canonical knowledge changes, LINE credential storage changes, durable workflow implementation, Vercel Blob as authority, renderer migration to PixiJS by default, and unapproved Talk/Assign Task actions. [`docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §Out of Scope; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §9; `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md` §§4–7; `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md` §§Non-Negotiable Gates, Agent Office Implementation Decision]

## 3. NFR and governance inventory

| Area | Binding requirement and evidence boundary | Source trace |
|---|---|---|
| Tenancy | Every read/write uses session-derived tenant context and tenant-scoped repository/service lookup. URL identifiers are resolved within that tenant, not globally then checked. Browser tenant fields never select authority. | `docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §§Architectural Contract, Required Verification; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §§3.1, 5; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§2.1, 6, 8 |
| RBAC | Read overview/groups/reports/reviewer options requires `ownership:R` plus resource/PII scope. Named reviewer candidate access is an explicit active grant with group scope; writes require `ownership:W`; deny is authoritative. | `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§2.2, 4–6; `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md` §Server authorization matrix |
| PII and secrets | Mask/filter on server. Do not return/render/log raw LINE credentials, OA IDs, tokens, secret references, raw transcript text, unmasked PII, hidden user detail, prompt/reasoning text, or raw task payload. A Tenant Owner choice cannot weaken policy masking, consent, retention, or recipient scope. | `docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §§Architectural Contract, Required Verification; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §§3.3, 5; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§2.3, 4–6, 9; `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md` §6 |
| Error contract and input validation | The server validates template/KPI, recipient, schedule, and alert-cap constraints. `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` may provide safe field reasons; `429 RATE_LIMITED` provides retry guidance. Neither response may include a secret, SQL/internal error, raw PII, or another tenant identifier; the UI exposes safe field/retry states. | `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§4.3, 5–6; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §6 AC-05–AC-06 |
| Audit and concurrency | Every successful mutable control-plane write needs an opaque audit ID; failed authorization/validation mutates nothing. Writes use a revision and return safe `409 VERSION_CONFLICT` rather than overwriting. | `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§4.2–4.3, 5–6, 8; `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md` §Server authorization matrix |
| Availability and fail-closed behavior | Missing/stale/revoked/unavailable runtime evidence returns blocked/pending/safe source state and performs no LINE action. Unregistered/disabled groups make no LLM/MCP call and disclose no identifier existence. `401`, `403`, `404`, `422`, `429`, and `503` yield only their documented safe state/error payloads. | `docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §§Architectural Contract, Required Verification; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §5; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§4.4–6 |
| Performance and freshness | List APIs are cursor-paginated, default/clamped server limit 25. Presence uses current display state and `updatedAt`; stale or unavailable data must freeze/label the scene rather than simulate activity. A future renderer change needs measured performance evidence. | `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§4.1, 9; `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md` §§5–7; `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md` §Agent Office Implementation Decision |
| Accessibility | Every state has text plus icon/status treatment, keyboard path, usable denied/error states, contrast beyond colour, reduced-motion/static fallback, and DOM list parity for the scene. | `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §6; `docs/design/visual-office-design-spec.md` §§2, 6; `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md` §§2, 4, 7; `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md` §Test and Acceptance Matrix |
| No-deception | Do not treat configuration/preflight, a UI control, audit ID, saved schedule, browser timer, animation, or mock fixture as live runtime/delivery truth. Use source/as-of labels and explicit demo/unavailable states. | `docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md` §§Architectural Contract, Required Verification; `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md` §5; `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md` §§2.3, 3–4.4, 6–7, 9; `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md` §6 |

## 6. Preflight and graph interpretation

The preflight report is a documentation/governance health signal, not implementation evidence. Its trust hierarchy places current code and executed tests above design/contract intent, and design/contract intent above planning claims. Therefore this scope report preserves the Visual Office sources as approved design/contract intent while retaining the graph's specified-not-implemented statuses and all runtime/deployment uncertainty. [Preflight `trust_hierarchy`, CRIT-001–003; Doc graph `authority_notice`, Visual Office nodes]

The derived document graph provides traceability only; it states that canonical authority remains with each source fact class and with `gks/00_index/atomic_index.jsonl` for Phase 2 discovery. It identifies CR-012 as approved contract/design, FEAT34 as approved design-only, the API contract as candidate-not-bound, the frontend execution plan as blocked on Phase 2 promotion, and the module/ADR artifacts as inbound-only proposals. [Doc graph `authority_notice`; nodes `req:CR-012`, `doc:feat34-governed-line-visual-office`, `doc:visual-office-api-v1`, `doc:visual-office-frontend-execution-plan`, `doc:mod-visual-office-control-plane-proposal`, `doc:adr-068-visual-office-rbac-proposal`]

## 7. Scope conclusion

The complete current scope is a governed, tenant-scoped **control plane and design/contract inventory**, not a released LINE Copilot or report-delivery feature. Functional work remains gated by Phase 2/Phase 3 acceptance and by the contract-test and runtime/delivery evidence listed above. Until those gates close, the only valid product state claims are configuration intent, blocked/pending preflight, and explicitly labeled unavailable, stale, denied, revoked, or demo states.
